## Answer

Per `worker/src/services/ai-dm.md` (the doc for `worker/src/services/ai-dm.ts`):

- **`askDM(ai, char, session, action, combatContext?)`** (line 81) is the main DM-turn function. It first calls the primary model **`@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast`** (JSON object format, temp 0.85, 1024 tokens).
- **On failure (throw)**, it retries with the fallback model **`@cf/mistral/mistral-7b-instruct-v0.2-lora`**.
- **If both models fail**, `askDM` returns **`fallbackNarrative`** (a canned response) instead of propagating an error.
- For **invalid/malformed JSON** from a model, **`parseAIResponse`** handles it: it strips markdown code fences, extracts the first `{…}` block from the text, and fills in default values for any missing fields of `AIDMResponse` — it also reads from both `choices[0].message.content` (OpenAI-style) and the legacy `response` field.
- Output is further sanitized: at most 4 `suggestedActions` and 8 `diceRolls` are retained.

Note: `generateQuest`, `generateBackstory`, and `generateLevelUpNarrative` only read the legacy `response` field, so with `llama-3.3` they can silently fall back to canned text or empty strings (tracked as `bugs.md` B-03).
